cover: Diplomatic shifts shake Europe while deadly disease breaches West African borders
cover_scene: A split composition showing the Kremlin towers bathed in twilight alongside medical quarantine tents set up on dusty African soil.

slides.scene: A grand neoclassical hall with polished floors, Russian and American flags standing behind empty chairs at a diplomatic table.
slides.headline: Moscow signals willingness to reopen talks
slides.body: Russia released imprisoned American Stephen Hubbard as US envoy Steve Witkoff visited Moscow with a peace framework. The Kremlin signaled readiness to hold three-way talks involving Ukraine and Washington by mid-November, though analysts caution a major breakthrough remains unlikely.

slides.scene: British fighter jets soaring over desert airfields lined with radars and Patriot battery installations under a hazy sunset.
slides.headline: Britain deploys warplanes to protect Riyadh
slides.body: The United Kingdom deployed combat aircraft to Saudi Arabia to defend the kingdom against persistent missile and drone strikes launched by Houthi forces. The deployment comes amid escalating regional tensions that have prompted US missions to prepare ordered departures.

slides.scene: A secluded tropical hospital perimeter with a guarded gate, medical warning notices, and heavy storm clouds overhead.
slides.headline: Nigeria confirms first case of Ebola
slides.body: Health authorities in Nigeria confirmed the nation's first Ebola case after an infected traveler arrived from abroad. Officials scrambled contact-tracing teams to prevent secondary transmission, sparking continent-wide concern as public health networks mobilize emergency containment protocols.

slides.scene: A stainless steel aerospace rocket on an industrial launchpad adjacent to high-tech assembly buildings in the American desert.
slides.headline: Musk advances Tesla and SpaceX merger
slides.body: Special board committees were established at Tesla and SpaceX to formally evaluate combining both companies into a single conglomerate. The unprecedented consolidation would unite commercial spaceflight, satellite telecom, and electric vehicle production under one corporate roof.

slides.scene: A massive European football arena lit by blinding stadium floodlights as celebratory banners unfurl from the upper decks.
slides.headline: Champions League sets all-time scoring record
slides.body: The newly expanded 36-team Champions League format generated a historic flood of goals, averaging over three scores per fixture across the league phase. Despite lingering criticism regarding competitive balance, the attacking surge produced record-breaking offensive statistics across the continent.
